steps.code:
# Loop to go to previous songs until we find a liked one
max_steps = 100  # safety limit
for i in range(max_steps):
    # Go to previous song
    prev_resp = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=login_response['access_token'])
    print(f"Step {i+1}: {prev_resp}")
    
    # Get current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=login_response['access_token'])
    print(f"Current song: {current['song_id']} - {current['title']}")
    
    # Check if liked
    privates = apis.spotify.show_song_privates(song_id=current['song_id'], access_token=login_response['access_token'])
    print(f"Liked: {privates['liked']}")
    
    if privates['liked']:
        print(f"Found liked song: {current['title']} (ID: {current['song_id']})")
        break
else:
    print("No liked song found within limit")
